blurb: Discover the sweeter and spookier side of Boston on this haunted donut walking tour. Enjoy delicious donuts and sweet treats while exploring the city’s eerie history, ghost stories, and local legends. Visit historic Granary Burying Ground, where famous Bostonians including Paul Revere, Samuel Adams, and John Hancock are buried. Continue past iconic landmarks like Faneuil Hall and Quincy Market before enjoying more treats at Boston Public Market. From there, venture into the historic North End, where narrow streets and old brick buildings provide the perfect setting for mysterious tales. Pass Old North Church and hear stories from Boston’s darker past before finishing at Copp’s Hill Burying Ground. Come hungry and ready for a fun mix of sweets, history, and spooky stories.
